stage: S6 requirements, not proof of an implemented browser executor
cases: Never infer consent, citizenship, sponsorship, active clearance or sensitive self-identification from a missing value
Unknown required fields stop assistance and become review questions
Private contact/address fields require explicit scoped disclosure
Optional self-identification, SMS consent and platform challenges stay manual
Native typed input and ambiguous dropdown/radio/checkbox values require exact reviewed mapping
Safe nonfinal navigation must not click submit, finish, apply, confirm or send controls
Visible upload and styled file controls may attach only current hash-approved packet bytes
Iframe, popup, hidden future-step and visually unlabeled fields require observable bounded discovery
Failures must be recorded per field without claiming it was filled
Start/review/fill records cannot be inferred from opening a page or preparing answers
Redacted run evidence must not expose private values, session tokens or credentials
Removed postings, access controls and CAPTCHA stop rather than trigger retries or evasion
